envoy_as.desc: Envoy Ingrith Goldrune (1x): cream tunic, belted blue trousers, gold-buckled belt, a gold-pinned blue cloak.

lordwarden.desc: Lord-Warden Hallgerd Sunmantle (1x): wine-red tunic, belted trousers, white fur mantle, rune circlet, short beard.

runemaster.desc: Rune-Master Alrik Runehammer (1x): leather apron over a grey tunic, belted trousers, rune-burned gloves, braided beard.

priestess.desc: Priestess Sunna Dawnward (1x): white wrap tunic, gold sash at the waist, belted skirt over leggings.

fridleif.desc: Captain Fridleif Thunderhelm (1x NPC): leather jerkin under a gilded tabard, belted trousers, spear. No plate.

groom.desc: Bodil Windmane (sky-horse keeper, 1x): quilted jerkin over a tunic, rope-belted trousers.

as_trader.desc: Nessa (stall-keeper, 1x): layered tunics (wine under cream), wide belt with pouches.

as_guide.desc: Orla (acolyte, contract guide, 1x): plain white tunic, belted trousers, a lamp.
